appDescription: Vehicle self-diagnosis and service center matching for Hyundai, Kia and Genesis owners.

function.name: REPORT_VEHICLE_PROBLEM
function.description: Records the vehicle problem the driver described, checks its safety level, and returns a preliminary result without opening any screen.

symptom.description: The driver's description of what is wrong with the vehicle, including the details already given in the conversation.

part.description: The vehicle area involved. Use other when it is unknown.

function.name: FIND_SERVICE_CENTER
function.description: Shows service centers for the problem the driver already reported, ordered by distance or by how soon service can start.

part.description: The vehicle area to be repaired.

sortBy.description: Whether to order centers by distance or by earliest service.

function.name: RECOMMEND_NEXT_CAR
function.description: Opens the next car recommendation based on the driver's registered vehicle record.
